assets.name: neuroniy
assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept. Image 1 is the exact identity reference for Neuroniy, the NII FIELD mascot. Image 2 is the STYLE reference for the website. Create a single friendly 3D pet-like character as a transparent cut-out. Preserve the core identity: round turquoise/cyan body, two large round WHITE eyes with small navy pupils looking slightly upward, a simple white open smiling mouth. Translate the flat circle into a soft matte turquoise spherical character, add only two tiny rounded arms and two tiny feet of the same turquoise material. One little arm is raised in a friendly greeting. The character should feel curious, intelligent, calm and charming, suitable for a serious adult learning community. Tactile smooth soft ceramic/paper texture, premium studio-rendered depth matching the site, no plastic shine. Front three-quarter view, whole character fully visible, centered with 15% transparent margin all around, square image. No separate scene, floor, furniture, clothes, text, letters, badge, props, speech bubble, watermark. Keep the original simple face recognizable and avoid resemblance to an animal.
